# nerves_time v0.4.12 - Table of Contents

> Keep time in sync on Nerves devices

## Pages

- [nerves_time](https://nerves-time.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://nerves-time.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [NervesTime](https://nerves-time.hexdocs.pm/NervesTime.md): Keep time in sync on Nerves devices
- [NervesTime.FileTime](https://nerves-time.hexdocs.pm/NervesTime.FileTime.md): FileTime simulates a real-time clock using a file's mtime
- [NervesTime.RealTimeClock](https://nerves-time.hexdocs.pm/NervesTime.RealTimeClock.md): Behaviour for real-time clocks implementations.

- [NervesTime.RealTimeClock.BCD](https://nerves-time.hexdocs.pm/NervesTime.RealTimeClock.BCD.md): Convert between integers and binary-coded decimals (BCD)
- [NervesTime.Waiter](https://nerves-time.hexdocs.pm/NervesTime.Waiter.md): Waits for `NervesTime.SystemTime` to successfully set a sane real time.
